name: GUNSHI
source:
If you win you get a reward, if you lose you are humiliated.

My name is Gaius Lavienus.

As per Princess Elena's precise suggestions, I will lead the third company to victory.
If I win, princess Elena will reward me.
If I lose, princess Elena will humiliate me.
